name: anthropic_stream_message_start_and_delta_with_cache
comment: Input usage (incl. cache) arrives in message_start; cumulative output in the final message_delta. Same inclusive normalization as the body extractor: input 300 + cache_read 1000 + cache_creation 200 = 1500.

name: anthropic_stream_no_cache
anthropic_stream_abandoned_after_message_start
comment: Stream cut off after message_start but before the terminal message_delta. The output is never finalized, so the event is untallied (no partial estimate).
